description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You are holding your censer implement.

You swing your censer in a wide arc, causing the smoke it issues to thicken. Until the start of your next turn, creatures within the smoke are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed], and all creatures outside the smoke are concealed to those within it.
